name: Kotodama
source: A Kotodama type monster girl. Kotodama monster girls look like typical high school girls. This Kotodama loves singing and hopes to be an idol however her singing is so unbelievably terrible it can cause physical damage to anyone listening to it. Her only fans are masochists who want their ears to bleed.
